rq: joint identification of raw language equivalence and latent intervention partition
primary_work: Varici et al., General Identifiability and Achievability for Causal Representation Learning, AISTATS 2024
decision: NARROWED BEYOND GENERAL UNCOUPLED-INTERVENTION CRL IDENTIFIABILITY — NOT ADOPTED
reason: Observational data plus two uncoupled hard intervention environments per latent node already identify the latent DAG and latent variables up to permutation and component-wise diffeomorphism and constructively recover the unknown environment pairing. These guarantees do not identify raw-utterance equivalence, semantic refinements within intervention-equivalent classes, or a unique denotation; joint coordinate/environment/utterance recodings remain observationally equivalent.
surviving_candidate: After recovering the latent DAG, latent coordinates, and strongest intervention-target partition identifiable from all legitimate observational and uncoupled interventional environments, determine whether a preregistered raw-language law uniquely refines only the remaining intervention-aliased blocks and jointly identifies utterance equivalence, residual semantic target partition, and denotation while eliminating every joint coordinate/environment/utterance recoding preserving the complete multi-environment law.
